boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase activities on and around the University of Denver campus, with access details for planning a low-key outing.

cards.title: See a rotating visual-art exhibition
cards.subtitle: Shwayder Art Building, 2121 E. Asbury Ave.
cards.notes: Meet at the Shwayder Art Building and browse the current exhibition together; check the gallery page before going because exhibitions and building access can change.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery visit with changing student and professional work.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is always free at the Vicki Myhren Gallery, which is located in DU's Shwayder Art Building.
cards.access_notes: When exhibitions are up, listed hours are 12–5 p.m. Tuesday–Friday; DU building access may require a University ID or advance coordination for visitors.

cards.title: Visit the student-run Davis Gallery
cards.subtitle: Shwayder Art Building, 2121 E. Asbury Ave.
cards.notes: Pair this with the neighboring Vicki Myhren Gallery, then pause to compare one work each; verify the current exhibition schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A student-run exhibition space sharing the Shwayder Art Building's main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is always free at Davis Gallery, located on the main floor of Shwayder Art Building at the University of Denver.
cards.access_notes: When exhibitions are up, listed hours are 12–5 p.m. Tuesday–Friday; DU building access may require a University ID or advance coordination for visitors.

cards.title: Browse the library's public exhibits
cards.subtitle: Anderson Academic Commons, 2150 E. Evans Ave.
cards.notes: Walk the three levels and pick an exhibit to discuss; displays change each quarter, so use the current-exhibits page to choose a timely stop.
cards.short_summary: Library exhibits spanning art, scholarship, and materials from DU collections.
cards.evidence_claim: All University Libraries exhibits are open to the public and are located in public areas on all three levels of Anderson Academic Commons.
cards.access_notes: A valid DU ID is required to enter campus buildings, including the library.

cards.title: Take a self-guided tree walk
cards.subtitle: Meet at the Mary Reed Building information kiosk
cards.notes: Download or pick up the Tree Walk Guide, then wander the gardens at your own pace while keeping to the Arboretum's passive-appreciation rules.
cards.short_summary: A campus arboretum with a free self-guided route through its plant collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chester M. Alter Arboretum is free and open to the public 365 days a year, and self-guided tours are available at no charge.
cards.access_notes: Information kiosk: southwest corner of Mary Reed Building, 2199 S. University Blvd. Follow Arboretum rules and do not pick or damage plants.

cards.entity_name: Chester M. Alter Arboretum guided walking tour
cards.title: Book a free guided garden walk
cards.subtitle: Chester M. Alter Arboretum; May–September group tours
cards.notes: Gather a garden club, residence-hall group, or friends and request a guided walk; wear comfortable shoes, sun protection, and bring water for grassy areas.
cards.short_summary: An hour-long guided introduction to DU's gardens, collections, and Arboretum history.
cards.evidence_claim: All guided Chester M. Alter Arboretum tours are free of charge and are offered May through September.
cards.access_notes: Tours meet at the Arboretum information kiosk by Mary Reed Building; reservations and seasonal availability apply.

cards.title: Follow DU's campus art walking tour
cards.subtitle: Outdoor and indoor art installations across campus
cards.notes: Download the tour before setting out, choose a few stops that interest the group, and keep the route flexible around building-access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced way to locate artworks installed around the University of Denver campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Vicki Myhren Gallery provides a downloadable campus art walking tour for art installations around DU.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor works are the simplest option; some campus buildings require a valid DU ID or advance visitor coordination.

cards.entity_name: Lamont School of Music free recitals
cards.title: Choose a free recital or student show
cards.subtitle: Lamont School of Music and DU recital halls
cards.notes: Check the current arts calendar, invite a friend, and select a recital or small student show marked free; confirm any ticket or reservation detail before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Recurring free performances from DU's campus arts scene.
cards.evidence_claim: DU states that its campus arts scene includes dozens of free recitals and small student shows every month.
cards.access_notes: Individual events may have their own schedules or free-ticket requirements; check the event listing before attending.

cards.title: Cheer at a DU basketball game
cards.subtitle: Student ticket offer; verify the current schedule
cards.notes: Use the student-ticket offer for a basketball game, coordinate seats with friends, and review the athletics schedule and entry instructions before game day.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost student-ticket option for supporting DU basketball.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Denver states that students can take advantage of free student tickets for sports such as basketball.
cards.access_notes: For DU students; ticket availability, schedule, and venue entry procedures should be confirmed with athletics before attending.

cards.title: Go to a DU volleyball match
cards.subtitle: Student ticket offer; verify the current schedule
cards.notes: Plan around the current volleyball schedule and claim the student ticket before the match; meeting up beforehand makes it an easy group outing.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost student-ticket option for watching DU volleyball.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Denver states that students can take advantage of free student tickets for sports such as volleyball.
cards.access_notes: For DU students; ticket availability, schedule, and venue entry procedures should be confirmed with athletics before attending.

cards.title: Join a Mountain Campus program
cards.subtitle: DU's 720-acre mountain campus, about two hours from Denver
cards.notes: Look for a student program that includes Mountain Campus access, then plan the trip with the sponsoring office; follow program guidance for transport, gear, and conditions.
cards.short_summary: A DU mountain-campus setting available to students without an extra access charge.
cards.evidence_claim: DU describes its 720-acre James C. Kennedy Mountain Campus as accessible to all students at no extra cost.
cards.access_notes: Access is through DU student opportunities; confirm the sponsoring program's transportation, timing, and any required equipment before participating.
